# Topological_Origin_of_Metastability

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The principle that the existence and hierarchy of metastable states in a dynamical system are determined by the topology of the underlying interaction graph, not just by energy values. Guides design of network topologies in TCC/iNEST to intentionally create desired metastable states for computation or memory.
